description: This file contains tests for the 'credits' utilities and their integration with data structures used in the project. It verifies functions like 'usdToCredits' and 'getCreditsPerUsd', as well as ensuring that data normalization for credits fields includes both camelCase and snake_case keys.

methods.name: getCreditsPerUsd
methods.description: Returns the number of credits per USD, defaulting to 20000 if environment variable is unset.

methods.name: usdToCredits
methods.description: Converts a USD amount into credits, returning 0 for invalid inputs.
